description.raw: '''Active:''' After a 1-second delay, '''Twitch''' becomes [[File:Ambush_3.png|20px|link=Stealth#Camouflage|An icon representing the keyword Camouflage]] [[:Stealth#Camouflage|camouflaged]] for a duration. Attacking or casting ''[[File:Twitch Venom Cask.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Venom Cask|An icon for Twitch's ability Venom Cask]] [[Twitch#Venom Cask|Venom Cask]]'' or ''[[File:Twitch Contaminate.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Contaminate|An icon for Twitch's ability Contaminate]] [[Twitch#Contaminate|Contaminate]]'' ends ''Ambush'' immediately.
description.text: Active: After a 1-second delay, Twitch becomes camouflaged for a duration. Attacking or casting Venom Cask or Contaminate ends Ambush immediately.

description2.raw: During this time, '''Twitch''' gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 10% '''bonus''' movement speed, increased to 30% while facing enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] within a 1000-unit radius who cannot see him.
description2.text: During this time, Twitch gains  10% bonus movement speed, increased to 30% while facing enemy champions within a 1000-unit radius who cannot see him.

description3.raw: Upon breaking stealth, '''Twitch''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed for 6 seconds.
description3.text: Upon breaking stealth, Twitch gains  bonus attack speed for 6 seconds.

description4.raw: When an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] dies while afflicted with ''[[File:Twitch Deadly Venom.png|20xpx|border|link=Twitch#Deadly Venom|An icon for Twitch's ability Deadly Venom]] [[Twitch#Deadly Venom|Deadly Venom]]'', ''Ambush's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is reset.
description4.text: When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Deadly Venom, Ambush's  cooldown is reset.

notes.raw: * Entering stealth cancels '''Twitch's''' current basic attack. * ''Ambush'' follows the same rules as stealth but he can still perform actions normally before entering [[File:Ambush_3.png|20px|link=Stealth#Camouflage|An icon representing the keyword Camouflage]] [[:Stealth#Camouflage|camouflage]]. Activating [[File:Recall.png|20xpx|border|link=Recall|An icon representing Recall]] [[Recall]] during the 1-second delay allows him to [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|channel]] it while stealthed. * If '''Twitch''' enters [[File:Stasis icon.png|20px|link=Types_of_Crowd_Control#Stasis|An icon representing the keyword Stasis]] [[:Types_of_Crowd_Control#Stasis|stasis]] during the delay, he will gain the [[File:Ambush_3.png|20px|link=Stealth#Camouflage|An icon representing the keyword Camouflage]] [[:Stealth#Camouflage|camouflage]] after the stasis ends. * Using a basic attack [[File:Breaking stealth icon.png|20px|link=Stealth#Breaking_stealth|An icon representing the keyword Break stealth]] [[:Stealth#Breaking_stealth|breaks the stealth]] at the start of the attack windup.
notes.text:
Entering stealth cancels Twitch's current basic attack.
Ambush follows the same rules as stealth but he can still perform actions normally before entering camouflage. Activating Recall during the 1-second delay allows him to channel it while stealthed.
If Twitch enters stasis during the delay, he will gain the camouflage after the stasis ends.
Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
